thought: Blinded by acid at 3. Topped her blind school at 18.
support: Kafi, from Hisar, Haryana, was attacked with acid during Holi in 2011 at age 3, losing her sight. Studying through audiobooks and NCERT texts at the Institute for the Blind in Chandigarh's Sector 26, she scored 95.2% in her Class 10 boards in 2023, then topped the school's humanities stream in Class 12 with 95.6% - 478 out of 500 - when CBSE declared results in May 2025. She now aims to become an IAS officer.
